title: Great Christmas Tree Sale
synopsis: The price of a Christmas tree in China this year is only half of last year’s  price, and you can get a tree with 100 decorations for only 39 yuan ($6). Find out why in today’s lesson.

fullText.simplified:
圣诞树大降价

    马上就是圣诞节了。以前，每到这个时候，圣诞装饰品都会卖得很贵，圣诞树、彩灯、彩球等都非常好卖。但是今年，圣诞装饰品的价格只是去年的一半。
    现在，1.5米的圣诞树加上100个装饰圣诞树要用到的彩灯、彩球等，只要39元。李先生是一个5岁女孩的爸爸，女儿很喜欢过圣诞节，所以他每年都会给女儿买圣诞树和圣诞装饰品。他惊喜地说：“去年我买了100多元，但好像也没有什么东西。今年才花了50元，就买到了好多东西。”
    有店主说，今年圣诞装饰品大降价的最大原因是国家提出的“节俭风”。以前每到圣诞节，很多公司都会买很大的圣诞树来装饰办公室。他们看重的是圣诞树是否漂亮，不太看重价钱。但是因为“节俭风”，没有公司买圣诞树了。现在买圣诞树的大多是有小孩的家庭，更看重价钱是否划算。所以只有降价，才能保证销量。
fullText.traditional:
聖誕樹大降價

    馬上就是聖誕節了。以前，每到這個時候，聖誕裝飾品都會賣得很貴，聖誕樹、彩燈、綵球等都非常好賣。但是今年，聖誕裝飾品的價格只是去年的一半。
    現在，1.5米的聖誕樹加上100個裝飾聖誕樹要用到的彩燈、綵球等，只要39元。李先生是一個5歲女孩的爸爸，女兒很喜歡過聖誕節，所以他每年都會給女兒買聖誕樹和聖誕裝飾品。他驚喜地說：“去年我買了100多元，但好像也沒有什麼東西。今年才花了50元，就買到了好多東西。”
    有店主說，今年聖誕裝飾品大降價的最大原因是國家提出的“節儉風”。以前每到聖誕節，很多公司都會買很大的聖誕樹來裝飾辦公室。他們看重的是聖誕樹是否漂亮，不太看重價錢。但是因為“節儉風”，沒有公司買聖誕樹了。現在買聖誕樹的大多是有小孩的家庭，更看重價錢是否划算。所以只有降價，才能保證銷量。

raw.synopsis: The price of a Christmas tree in China this year is only half of last year’s  price, and you can get a tree with 100 decorations for only 39 yuan ($6). Find out why in today’s lesson.
sentence_translations: Soon it will be Christmas season.
Previously, this time each year Christmas ornaments would sell at high prices, with Christmas trees, lights, bulbs, etc. all selling very well.
This year however, the price of Christmas ornaments is only half of that of last year.
Now, a 1.5 meters tall Christmas tree including 100 lights, christmas balls and other things required for decorating the tree is only 39 yuan.
Mr. Li is a father of a five-year-old daughter.
His daughter really enjoys celebrating Christmas, so each year he buys a Christmas tree and decorations for his daughter.
Pleasantly surprised, he says: "Last year I spent over 100 yuan, but still felt like I hadn't gotten  anything. This year I only spent 50 yuan, but could buy a lot of things."
One shop owner says that the biggest reason for this year's sale on Christmas ornaments is the new frugality campaign put forward by the government.
Before, every year at Christmas many companies would by large Christmas trees to decorate their offices.
For them, what is important is whether or not the Christmas tree looks good, and not so much the price.
But because of the frugality campaign, no companies are buying Christmas trees.
Now it is instead families having small children who buy Christmas trees, and they put more value into whether or not the price is reasonable.
The only way to guarantee sales volumes is therefore to lower the price.
